text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to cut the release tag tomorrow 16:00 PT. Can folks ✅ the publish checklist and artifact names?
kevin: On it. Which tag format are we using this cycle? vMAJOR.MINOR.patch or include build metadata?
maria: Stick with vX.Y.Z. We’ll keep build metadata in the release body not the tag. Example: `git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "runtime: release v1.12.0"`
jen: Is the CI job that uploads assets to GH releases already gated by the signed-commit check? I want to avoid unsigned artifacts slipping through.
maria: yes — release.yml requires the `signed-tags` check and `ci/artifacts:upload` only runs when tag exists and `GITHUB_REF` =~ refs/tags/v.*
liam: devbot just posted that the nightly artifacts succeeded: `build/runtime-linux-amd64.tar.gz (sha256: a1b2...)` — should we also include darwin/arm64?
devbot: ci-bot: All builds green. Artifacts: linux-amd64, linux-arm64, darwin-amd64, darwin-arm64. Checksums attached.
sara: Quick verification step: please run `sha256sum` locally against the S3 objects before we tag. I caught a mismatched checksum last release.
kevin: Agreed. My checklist: 1) confirm changelog entries, 2) verify artifact checksums, 3) create annotated tag, 4) push tag, 5) create draft GH release with assets, 6) assign relevant reviewers to release notes.
maria: Perfect. For changelog: please open PRs linking to changelog/ for any last-minute bullets. I’ll squash minor typos. Also I’ll paste a release template in case helpful.
maria: ```Release v1.12.0
- Highlights: runtime optimizations for KV cache and reduced memory overhead
- Notable bugfixes: fixed warmup crash on multi-gpu setups
- Upgrade notes: default batching policy bumped to auto-v2
Artifacts: runtime-1.12.0-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz
Checksums: attached as checksums.txt
```
jen: For the annotated tag message, include the changelog link + SHA from the main build. I usually do: `git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "v1.12.0 — changelog: https://github.com/redwood/repo/..../CHANGELOG.md#v1.12.0 — sha: abcdef"`
kevin: After pushing tag, who will click the GH UI to create the draft release? We should avoid multiple people creating duplicates.
maria: I'll handle the GH draft + attach artifacts (I’ll use the release API). If anyone needs to attach extra test artifacts ping me.
liam: I'll verify checksums and run a quick smoke deploy to staging after tag is pushed. ETA 20m after tag.
sara: Reminder: update the internal release-notes ticket with the final Release Manager (cc @maria).
kevin: One more: confirm the signed assets checklist in the release body: `signed-by: rel-signing-key@redwood.com`
maria: noted. Final timeline: 16:00 PT tag, 16:05 push, 16:10 GH draft and assets, 16:30 post annoucements. If anything slips, bump to 17:00 PT.
jen: LGTM. I’ll leave a quick review on the changelog PRs and re-run the checksum script.
kevin: 👍 I'll stand by to create the annotated tag when you give the go.
maria: thanks all — ping me here when you have checksum ok and I’ll do the tag. :rocket:
